where.if: and ( u.user_name like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or u.openid like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or cast(u.user_id as char) like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or m.name like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') )

mapper.select: select u.user_id, u.user_name, u.openid, u.phone_masked, mu.role, mu.status as membership_status, mu.create_time from merchant_users mu join sys_user u on u.user_id = mu.user_id where mu.merchant_id = #{merchantId} order by case mu.role when 'OWNER' then 0 when 'ADMIN' then 1 else 2 end, mu.create_time asc, u.user_id asc
select count(1) from sys_user u join merchants m on m.id = u.merchant_id left join merchant_users mu on mu.merchant_id = u.merchant_id and mu.user_id = u.user_id

select u.user_id, u.merchant_id, m.name as merchant_name, u.user_name, u.openid, mu.role, mu.status as membership_status, u.create_time, u.update_time from sys_user u join merchants m on m.id = u.merchant_id left join merchant_users mu on mu.merchant_id = u.merchant_id and mu.user_id = u.user_id
order by u.create_time desc, u.user_id desc limit #{limit} offset #{offset}

select u.user_id, u.merchant_id, m.name as merchant_name, u.user_name, u.openid, mu.role, mu.status as membership_status, u.create_time, u.update_time from sys_user u join merchants m on m.id = u.merchant_id left join merchant_users mu on mu.merchant_id = u.merchant_id and mu.user_id = u.user_id where u.user_id = #{userId}
